shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '45,90p' && sed -n '1,180p' AGENTS.md && git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && rg -n \"askAfterConnect|frame.type === 'pong'\" src/transport -g '*.test.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md && rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|repoint-spec-anchors'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- specs src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "test(transport): flatten frame type dispatch" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
